notes.title: CrossTrix v1.02 Release
notes.content:
Greetings all,

Been hard at work on joystick/gamepad support this week. With the release of v1.02 comes:

* Support for joysticks/gamepads for both players.
* Fixes for joystick movement in the various sections of the game. Have tested across all areas and appears to be fully working.

Have tested this version with a ps2 controller and a ps3 controller, and both worked properly after a fair bit of work. Let me know if anything does not work for you, and I'll look into it. As I don't have an xbox 360 controller, I was unable to test that.
